title:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, clear the compose cooldown when a compose never ran.

ANCHO
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, clear the compose cooldown when a compose never ran.

ANCHOR — this exact line already exists in the file. Match it verbatim. Do not paraphrase it, and do not invent any other anchor:
    if (isNonAttemptComposeResult(cb)) {

Immediately inside that branch, add one statement that deletes this gap's entry from the module-level `gapComposeLastAttemptAt` map (a Map<string, number> declared near the top of the same file, just below `const GAP_COMPOSE_COOLDOWN_MS`), keyed by the gap's id, so the gap becomes eligible for the auto-pick candidate set again instead of sitting out the full cooldown. Keep the existing console.log in that branch byte-for-byte unchanged. Add a one-line comment noting that a compose that never ran must not cost the gap its cooldown.

Do not modify the `else` branch. Do not change GAP_COMPOSE_COOLDOWN_MS. Do not change any other file.

DO NOT GUESS THE LOG LINE. An earlier attempt failed by inventing two old-strings that are nowhere in the file: `console.log("gap credit not bumped");` and `console.log("gap credit bumped, category calibration will now include", g.category);`. The real log line in that branch is one long concatenation starting `console.log("[gap-to-feature] non-attempt (failure_kind=" + String(cb.failure_kind ?? "-")`. Do not try to match it. Anchor only on the `if (isNonAttemptComposeResult(cb)) {` line, which is short, exact, and unique in the file.

WHY: the cooldown is stamped at pick-start by `if (!pointer.gap_id && gap.id) gapComposeLastAttemptAt.set(String(gap.id), Date.now());` and read by the eligibility filter `nowMs - (gapComposeLastAttemptAt.get(String(g.id ?? "")) ?? 0) >= GAP_COMPOSE_COOLDOWN_MS`. Since the stamp lands before feature_compose runs and is never cleared on a capacity refusal, a compose that never ran costs its gap five full minutes of exclusion. The comment above isNonAttemptComposeResult in this same file already states the principle — "A compose that never RAN is not a compose that FAILED" — and it was applied to failed_attempts and to category calibration but never to the cooldown. This change extends it to selection.

Add a test asserting both directions: after a non-attempt result the gap is immediately re-eligible, and after a genuine non-landing compose the gap is still cooled for the full interval.
